faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TNRD Sivaganga Record Clerk recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the TNRD Sivaganga Record Clerk recruitment is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum educational qualification required for the Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Record Clerk post is passing the 10th standard examination from a recognized board.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to the Record Clerk position?
faq.answer: The age limit for applying to the Record Clerk position is between 18 years and 37 years. Age relaxation is applicable for certain categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Record Clerk post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 15,900 to Rs. 58,600 per month, as per Pay Level-02.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the TNRD Sivaganga Record Clerk job?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply offline by downloading the application form from the official website and sending the duly filled form along with required documents to the specified address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for the Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Record Clerk post in the Rural Development and Panchayat Department Sivaganga.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for the TNRD Sivaganga Record Clerk recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for all categories (General/OBC, SC/ST) is Rs. 50. This fee should be paid as per the instructions in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Record Clerk position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Record Clerk position typically involves an Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Rural Development and Panchayat Department Sivaganga, which is https://sivaganga.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation for specific categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided. Persons with Disabilities get a 10-year extension, and Ex-Servicemen can apply between 18 and 55 years of age.
